message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has confirmed a time that works for all four partners: Thursday at 14:30. My next step is to book this meeting in the system. After booking, I need to let Brad know that the meeting is booked so he can send the confirmation email. I will use my two actions for this session to create the booking and then update the workspace.

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's in the system. Can you please send the confirmation email to the partners? Thanks!"}
